resources.string: Read-only, one request per action. Direct HTTPS means no local HTTP proxy, not a VPN bypass. Proxy HTTPS sends a fixed generate_204 request through the MahsaNG local HTTP proxy port if it is active. Neither result alone proves general proxy reliability. Platform TLS certificate and hostname verification remain enabled.
Direct HTTPS hostname (no scheme or URL path)

Handshake time measures TLS only, after TCP connect. No HTTP request or Xray outbound is tested. ALPN is shown only when available.
Standalone TLS handshake inspection requires Android 7.0 or later for secure hostname verification. No request was sent.
